What you want, and what made you want it — your own words, unedited.
No design and no solution; those belong in a spec.

`status:` is `draft` or `approved`. Anyone may write a draft, and an agent transcribing what the
owner dictates copies it word for word and never summarizes it. A draft you wrote yourself is a
proposal in your own voice, never a guess at the owner's. Only the owner sets `approved`, and only
an approved intent may be committed to — see `docs/intents/README.md`.

## Outcome

(optional, filled in later) What was built, or why nothing was.
